content.bridge_context: Understanding the diversity of people and cultures that make India unique.

units.title: Diversity of People
units.explanation: India is home to many tribes, nomads, and settled communities.
units.dual_language_instruction: Mention one tribe from your state. / अपने राज्य की एक जनजाति का नाम बताएं।

units.title: Bhakti and Sufi Movements
units.explanation: Spiritual movements that emphasized love and devotion to God, rejecting ritualism.
units.dual_language_instruction: Name a famous Bhakti saint. / एक प्रसिद्ध भक्ति संत का नाम बताएं।
